recipes.label: <color=red>Show an Ally the Wolf's truth<color=#005500>
recipes.startdescription:
<color=red>Even after all they have suffered, this one is still clinging to delusions of restraint and dignity. I could try to break them of those delusions - but this might just break them, instead.<color=#005500>

[This can give your Ally the Vicious aspect, but it might also fail and cause them to go mad. Slot trauma in to increase the chance of this working.]
